The messaging reef

Every command of the messaging reef: topics and queues, the engine under the rooms reef

O reef messaging

Todos os comandos do reef messaging: tópicos e filas, o motor sob o reef rooms

Opening · the reef and the rooms

The messaging reef is the engine the rooms run on

  • The engine: Topic and Queue, looked after by the nats Nereid (#576)
  • The conversation: the rooms reef, whose triton Nereid asks for a Topic per Room
Abertura · o reef e as salas

O reef messaging é o motor em que as salas rodam

  • O motor: Topic e Queue, cuidados pela Nereid nats (#576)
  • A conversa: o reef rooms, cuja Nereid triton pede um Topic por Room
Setup

What comes before the first topic?

Preparação

O que vem antes do primeiro tópico?

Setup · reefbuilt

One command applies the messaging reef and its kinds

Preparação · reefpronto

Um comando aplica o reef messaging e os seus kinds

~/example
# Apply the messaging reef$ nereus reef apply messaging✓ core/reefs/messaging 0.1.0 created (messaging.getnereus.dev/v1alpha1: queues, topics) Next steps:   nereus messaging --help  nereus nereid apply <nereid> --reef messaging
Setup · NATSplanned #1597

The nats Nereid looks after topics and queues

Preparação · NATSplanejado #1597

A Nereid nats cuida de tópicos e filas

~/example
# Apply the nats Nereid to the messaging reef$ nereus nereid apply nats \    --reef messaging✓ core/nereids/nats created, Ready, pinned to sha256:<digest>: see 'nereus messaging --help' Next steps:   nereus mandate create messaging-nats --reef messaging --nereid nats --match engine=nats --param jetstream=true # Every request of engine nats goes through it, with JetStream for the queues$ nereus mandate create messaging-nats \    --reef messaging \    --nereid nats \    --match engine=nats \    --param jetstream=true✓ core/mandates/messaging-nats created (reef: messaging, nereid: nats, match: engine=nats)
Topic

Where does a message go to everyone who listens?

Tópico

Para onde vai uma mensagem a todos que escutam?

Topic · create and listbuilt

A topic carries each message to everyone who listens

Tópico · create e listpronto

Um tópico leva cada mensagem a todos que escutam

~/example
# A topic for the orders, owned by a project$ nereus messaging topic create orders \    --owner project/triton \    --engine nats✓ messaging/topics/orders created (mandate: messaging-nats, nereid: nats) Next steps:   nereus messaging topic get orders # A topic only its owner's user writes to, keeping its messages for 30 days, up to 16M$ nereus messaging topic create team-ops \    --owner project/triton \    --engine nats \    --access owner \    --max-age 30d \    --max-bytes 16M✓ messaging/topics/team-ops created (mandate: nats, nereid: nats) Next steps:   nereus messaging topic get team-ops # The topics of the reef$ nereus messaging topic listTOPIC     OWNER           ENGINE  MANDATE  MAX AGE  MAX BYTES  READYorders    Project/triton  nats    nats     -        -          Trueteam-ops  Project/triton  nats    nats     30d      16M        True
Topic · get and deletebuilt

One topic shows where to reach it, and delete removes it

Tópico · get e deletepronto

Um tópico mostra onde alcançá-lo, e o delete o remove

~/example
# Every detail of one topic$ nereus messaging topic get ordersName:             ordersOwner:            Project/tritonEngine:           natsMandate:          natsNereid:           natsDeletion policy:  retainMax age:          unlimitedMax bytes:        unlimitedAccess:           sharedReady:            TrueConnection:       secret nereus-system/orders-topic (host, port, uri, subject) # Remove it$ nereus messaging topic delete orders✓ messaging/topics/orders deleted (deletionPolicy: retain, its messages are kept) Next steps:   nereus messaging topic list
Topic · applybuilt

A topic from a file: the dry run writes it, apply takes it

Tópico · applypronto

Um tópico de um arquivo: o dry run o escreve, o apply o recebe

~/example
# The YAML of a topic, written by a dry run$ nereus messaging topic create events \    --owner project/triton \    --engine nats \    --dry-run \    --output yamlapiVersion: messaging.getnereus.dev/v1alpha1kind: Topicmetadata:  name: eventsspec:  owner:    kind: Project    name: triton  engine: nats # Apply that file$ nereus messaging topic apply \    --from-file events.yaml✓ messaging/topics/events created Next steps:   nereus messaging topic list
Queue

Where does a message wait for one worker?

Fila

Onde uma mensagem espera por um worker?

Queue · create and listbuilt

A queue keeps each message until one worker takes it

Fila · create e listpronto

Uma fila guarda cada mensagem até um worker pegá-la

~/example
# A queue for the builds to run$ nereus messaging queue create builds \    --owner project/triton \    --engine nats✓ messaging/queues/builds created (mandate: messaging-nats, nereid: nats) Next steps:   nereus messaging queue get builds # The queues of the reef$ nereus messaging queue listQUEUE   OWNER           ENGINE  MANDATE  READYbuilds  Project/triton  nats    nats     True
Queue · get and deletebuilt

A queue names its stream, and delete keeps its messages

Fila · get e deletepronto

Uma fila nomeia o seu stream, e o delete guarda as mensagens

~/example
# Every detail of one queue$ nereus messaging queue get buildsName:             buildsOwner:            Project/tritonEngine:           natsMandate:          natsNereid:           natsDeletion policy:  retainReady:            TrueConnection:       secret nereus-system/builds-queue (host, port, uri, subject, stream) # Remove it: its stream and messages stay$ nereus messaging queue delete builds✓ messaging/queues/builds deleted (deletionPolicy: retain, its messages are kept) Next steps:   nereus messaging queue list
Queue · apply and deletionPolicybuilt

A queue from a file, whose delete drops its messages

Fila · apply e deletionPolicypronto

Uma fila de um arquivo, cujo delete descarta as mensagens

~/example
# The YAML of a queue, written by a dry run$ nereus messaging queue create scratch \    --owner project/triton \    --engine nats \    --deletion-policy delete \    --dry-run \    --output yamlapiVersion: messaging.getnereus.dev/v1alpha1kind: Queuemetadata:  name: scratchspec:  owner:    kind: Project    name: triton  engine: nats  deletionPolicy: delete # Apply that file$ nereus messaging queue apply \    --from-file scratch.yaml✓ messaging/queues/scratch created Next steps:   nereus messaging queue list # Remove it, and its stream with it$ nereus messaging queue delete scratch✓ messaging/queues/scratch deleted (deletionPolicy: delete) Next steps:   nereus messaging queue list
Until the rooms reef

Which commands of the rooms reef still run under their first names?

Até o reef rooms

Quais comandos do reef rooms ainda rodam com os seus primeiros nomes?

Until the rooms reef · create · dry runbuilt

A dry run says what the session would be, and starts nothing

Até o reef rooms · create · simulaçãopronto

Uma simulação diz como seria a sessão, e não inicia nada

~/example
# What would happen, with no name given$ nereus messaging session create \    --dry-runwould start claude-code as a Nereid's name free on Triton in the room on Triton, if Triton serves orders, logged in to NATS with the nats-channel plugin
Until the rooms reef · createbuilt

A coding agent joins Triton's room with your own login

Até o reef rooms · createpronto

Um agente entra na sala do Tritão com o seu próprio login

~/example
# Start Claude Code as agent m15$ nereus messaging session create m15  messaging: https://triton.getnereus.dev/mcp (peer tools: whoami, list_agents, post_room, read_room)  the room only: Triton serves no orders, so no NATS login (--orders to listen for them)starting m15 with claude-code: in the room on Triton
Until the rooms reef · create · ordersbuilt

Where Triton serves orders, the agent also logs in to NATS

Até o reef rooms · create · ordenspronto

Onde o Tritão serve ordens, o agente também entra no NATS

~/example
# Log agent m15 in to NATS without a browser (SSH)$ nereus messaging session create m15 \    --use-device-codeTo log agent m15 in to NATS, open https://auth.getnereus.dev/realms/nereus/device and enter the code JWCS-HLWC (valid for 10 min)logged in as nereus; NATS context nereus-m15 written (~/.config/nats/context/nereus-m15.json, 0600), valid until 01:07
Until the rooms reef · listbuilt

Every agent connected to Triton, and who started it

Até o reef rooms · listpronto

Cada agente conectado ao Tritão, e quem o iniciou

~/example
# The agents connected to Triton$ nereus messaging session listOWNER   NAME  STATE  SINCE     LAST HEARTBEAT  STARTED BY  BUSY WITHbob     doto  ready  06:12:02  06:15:57        bob         -nereus  m16   ready  06:11:36  06:15:56        alice       -
Until the rooms reef · room followbuilt

A person follows the room where the agents talk

Até o reef rooms · room followpronto

Uma pessoa acompanha a sala onde os agentes conversam

~/example
# Follow the room nereus, until Ctrl-C$ nereus room follow \    --room nereus21:02:11  alice/speo  claim    #1406 in ../nereus-1406-size, paths controllers/vcluster/21:02:40  bob/doto    note     k3d-nereus is mine until 21:3021:30:02  bob/doto    release  k3d-nereus
